et.aff.12.d: Meteors periodically fall near players, damaging players and enemies at the impact and along four lines of fire.

et.ia.1.d: Full heal; max health +10%% this run
et.journal.ab.b.high_priest.s0.d: Stabs the target twice; the third thrust hits the target again while damaging everyone and blasting all players outward.
et.journal.ab.b.high_priest.s1.d: Marks a whirlpool under a random player; 3 sec later a waterspout erupts. The waterspout follows that player, continuously damaging players within 2.5 blocks.
et.journal.ab.b.high_priest.s2.d: When the cast finishes, damages everyone and reduces movement speed by 20% for 6 sec.
et.journal.ab.b.high_priest.s3.d: The courtyard floor is a 6×6 grid of tiles. Tiles about to flood glow blue for 3 sec, then flood, continuously damaging players standing on them. The pattern is different every time.
et.journal.ab.b.high_priest.s4.d: Steel spheres surface from time to time and drift around the courtyard, exploding when a player gets close and damaging everything within 2.2 blocks.
et.journal.ab.b.rift_mother.s0.d: Slaps the target, dealing damage and making them take damage every second for 3 sec.
et.journal.ab.b.rift_mother.s1.d: Spews a 4×20 stream of void at a random player, dealing damage and leaving a void pool along the line that continuously damages players in it.
et.journal.ab.b.rift_mother.s2.d: Plants a seed over a random player's head that detonates after 6 sec. If it detonates within 3 blocks of a gold-glowing Sunken Anchor at the edge of the arena, the Rift Mother takes 25% more damage for 10 sec and that anchor goes dark for 45 sec; otherwise it damages everyone. There are 3 Sunken Anchors around the arena.
et.journal.ab.b.rift_mother.s3.d: Silt slugs crawl out of the cracks at the arena's edge and creep slowly toward random players. A slug leaves 2-block-radius silt when it dies, lasting until the end of the next Gravity Collapse; standing in silt reduces movement speed by 50%.
et.journal.ab.b.rift_mother.s4.d: After the cast, pulls all players toward the center while dealing continuous damage. Players standing in silt when the cast ends aren't pulled and take no damage from it. Finally, players not in silt are sucked into the center and detonated. All silt then disappears.
et.journal.ab.b.rift_mother.s5.d: Marks players and spots in the arena one after another; a few seconds later, walls of mud push out from each along two straight lines in a cross or X, damaging players on the lines.
et.journal.ab.b.squid_general.s0.d: Retreats once each at 90%, 80% and 70% health, leaping to the next floating crag; the third retreat takes him to Last Stand Isle. On a wipe he returns to the last stop he reached, with his health reset to that stop's value.
et.journal.ab.b.squid_general.s1.d: Arrows cover the ground; 3 sec later every player on the platform is knocked back 12 blocks in the arrows' direction and takes damage.
et.journal.ab.b.squid_general.s10.d: Cast once at 40% health. The kraken at the bottom of the pit opens its eye, then a beam of light sweeps the whole isle: players outside the 90° behind the Squid-Faced General take damage and are knocked back 10 blocks. The safe zone turns during the beam: 90° on Normal, 135° on Heroic, 270° on Mythic; while it casts, the ground shows the path the safe zone will take.
et.journal.ab.b.squid_general.s2.d: Marks 3-block-radius landing spots under random players; javelins then fall from the sky, dealing damage.
et.journal.ab.b.squid_general.s3.d: Periodically summons Ink Squidlings or Rift Crawlers, which don't count toward progress. He keeps summoning while retreating and stops once the final battle begins.
et.journal.ab.b.squid_general.s4.d: The fight starts when a player steps onto the isle; 5 sec later the bridge to the isle sinks into the abyss. The bridge is restored when the Squid-Faced General is defeated or the party wipes.
et.journal.ab.b.squid_general.s5.d: Slashes a 120° cone in front twice, then marks a 3×10 line straight ahead and cleaves down along it.
et.journal.ab.b.squid_general.s6.d: Sailors appear at the isle's edge and mark lines toward three random players, then hurl homing javelins that deal damage and knock back along the line.
et.journal.ab.b.squid_general.s7.d: Splits the isle into two halves and lights ink-colored warnings in sequence; once lit, the ink tide surges in. Each hit adds a stack of Ink Tide: every stack deals damage each second and reduces movement speed by 8%, up to 5 stacks; being hit again refreshes it to 10 sec.
et.journal.ab.b.squid_general.s8.d: Splits the isle into three zones instead, lit in sequence.
et.journal.ab.b.squid_general.s9.d: Arrows cover the ground; 3 sec later every player is knocked back 12 blocks in the arrows' direction and takes damage. The direction changes each time.
et.journal.ab.b.squid_general.t: B3 · Corridor of Death · Last Stand Isle · Two phases
et.journal.ab.bosses.i: Krakin Delicious has 3 bosses. The Squid-Faced General first retreats three times along the Corridor of Death, then makes his last stand on Last Stand Isle.
et.journal.ab.m.anchor_brute.s0.d: Alternates. Chain Sweep: a 180°, 6-block-radius arc in front that deals damage and drags players 3 blocks toward the brute. Anchor Drop: damages everything within 4 blocks.
et.journal.ab.m.angler_hunter.s0.d: Fires a 2×14 beam at a random player within 16 blocks. Every third cast becomes Lure Light: Scatter, three 2×10 beams 30° apart.
et.journal.ab.m.ballast_hauler.s0.d: Marks a 3-block-radius landing spot under a random player within 16 blocks; 3 sec later a ballast stone drops, dealing damage and slowing them for 2 sec.
et.journal.ab.m.deep_cultist.s0.d: Gives monsters within 12 blocks (including itself) a water shield worth 15% of their max health for 8 sec. The shield absorbs damage and bursts once broken through.
et.journal.ab.m.deep_cultist.s1.d: Damages a random player within 20 blocks.
et.journal.ab.m.gill_brute.s0.d: Alternates Surge Hammer (120°, 5-block radius in front, knocks back 4 blocks) and Backswing (180°, 5-block radius behind).
et.journal.ab.m.harpooner.s0.d: Throws a harpoon at the target's current position, damaging players within 1.4 blocks of where it lands.
et.journal.ab.m.harpooner.s1.d: Marks a 1.6×16 line toward a random player within 16 blocks; the line turns to follow that player. The harpoon flies along the line, damaging the first player it touches and pulling them 6 blocks toward the Harpooner.
et.journal.ab.m.horn_caller.s0.d: Monsters within 12 blocks (including itself) take 25% less damage for 8 sec.
et.journal.ab.m.ink_squidling.note: Appears in groups and moves fast. Summoned squidlings don't count toward progress.
et.journal.ab.m.ink_squidling.s0.d: On death, leaves a 2.5-block-radius ink pool underfoot for 4 sec. Players in it are slowed.
et.journal.ab.m.innsmouth_elder.s0.d: Monsters other than the Elder within 8 blocks are immune to crowd control and their casts can't be interrupted. The area is shown by a crescent sigil underfoot.
et.journal.ab.m.innsmouth_elder.s2.d: Two random players within 20 blocks have movement speed reduced by 30% and take 10% more damage for 6 sec. The Bell of Purity can cleanse it.
et.journal.ab.m.innsmouth_elder.s3.d: Shoots a scale barb at a random player within 24 blocks.
et.journal.ab.m.reef_octopus.s0.d: Grabs a random non-tank player, rooting them and dealing damage every second until the octopus loses another 3% of its max health. The arm holding the player glows.
et.journal.ab.m.reef_octopus.s1.d: Squirts ink in a 90°, 10-block cone in front, dealing damage and blinding players hit for 3 sec; it also splatters 4 ink puddles (1.5-block radius) that last 30 sec and deal damage and blind for 3 sec on touch.
et.journal.ab.m.reef_octopus.s2.d: About every 20 sec, hides in a rock crevice for 3 sec, untargetable, and marks a 3×16 route toward a random player; it then bursts out along the route, damaging and knocking back players in its path, and stops when it hits a wall.
et.journal.ab.m.rift_crawler.note: Appears in groups and moves fast. Also summoned by the Squid-Faced General (those don't count toward progress).
et.journal.ab.m.rift_crawler.s0.d: At the start of combat, fixates on a random player and keeps chasing them, ignoring threat; picks a new target when that player goes down.
et.journal.ab.m.rift_crawler.s1.d: Hits apply a stack of Erosion, reducing healing taken by 5% for 6 sec. Stacks up to 4 times.
et.journal.ab.m.rift_preacher.note: Rotation: Void Seed → Tentacle Eruption → Void Seed → Rend.
et.journal.ab.m.rift_preacher.s0.d: Plants a seed over a random player's head; 6 sec later it bursts on that player, damaging other players within 6 blocks. The carrier takes damage too.
et.journal.ab.m.rift_preacher.s1.d: Marks 2.5-block-radius spots under every player and at 2 more random spots; 3 sec later tentacles burst from the ground, dealing damage and knocking up.
et.journal.ab.m.rift_preacher.s2.d: Tears open a 5×20 line toward a random player, dealing damage and leaving a void pool along the line that continuously damages players in it.
et.journal.ab.m.skew_idol.note: Cannot move; turns slowly toward its target and has no melee attack.
et.journal.ab.m.skew_idol.s0.d: Marks two perpendicular 3×16 lines crossing at a random player; 3 sec later players on the lines take damage. Alternates between a cross and an X.
et.journal.ab.m.tendril_priest.s0.d: When the cast finishes, chains a random player within 16 blocks and channels for 6 sec, steadily pulling them toward the priest and dealing damage every second.
et.journal.ab.m.tendril_priest.s1.d: The chain breaks if the chained player gets more than 12 blocks from the priest. If the chain breaks or the channel is interrupted, the priest is stunned for 5 sec and takes 30% more damage.
et.journal.ab.m.the_descended.note: Rotation: Anchor Chain Lash → Bubble Prison → Anchor Chain Lash → Pressure Dive.
et.journal.ab.m.the_descended.s0.d: Swings the anchor chain around itself in a 7-block radius; only the 90° behind it is safe.
et.journal.ab.m.the_descended.s1.d: A 2-block-radius bubble circle appears under each player; players still in their own circle 3 sec later are trapped in a bubble, floating for 2 sec and taking damage. Each circle then releases a bubble that drifts along the ground; any player it touches is trapped the same way and the bubble pops.
et.journal.ab.m.the_descended.s2.d: Damages every player in the area and pulls everyone 4 blocks closer.
et.journal.ab.m.tide_warden.s0.d: Stabs the target and applies a stack of Brine Rot: 5% more damage taken and 5% less movement speed for 15 sec, stacking up to 10 times. The Bell of Purity can cleanse it.
et.journal.ab.m.tide_warden.s1.d: Marks a whirlpool under a random player within 20 blocks; 3 sec later a waterspout erupts. The waterspout follows that player, continuously damaging players within 2.5 blocks.
et.journal.ab.m.void_deacon.s0.d: A steady cast that fires homing void bolts at a random player in sight within 24 blocks.
et.journal.ab.m.void_tentacle.note: Can't move; slowly turns toward its target.
et.journal.ab.m.void_tentacle.s0.d: Casts in order: front-left sweep → slam → front-right sweep → slam. Sweep: 90° to the front-left or front-right, 6-block radius, knocks back 6 blocks. Slam: a 3×8 strip straight ahead.
et.journal.ab.m.void_tentacle.s1.d: Turns to its target and marks a fixed 2-block-radius circle 5 blocks in front of it, then slams down on it after a 3-second cast. The damage is split among players in the circle; if no one is in it, it damages everyone.
et.journal.ab.mech.s0.d: The Rift Trench has 7 Abyss Gates in small, medium and large sizes. Interact with a gate and monsters pour out wave after wave; the gate closes once all of its monsters are cleared. The Rift Mother can only be challenged after 3 gates are closed. Progress comes from the gate monsters. On a wipe, open gates reset.
et.journal.ab.mech.s1.d: One per party.  to take it at the entrance to the Corridor of Death; it goes in slot 9. Using it reduces damage taken by 40% for a short time and grants immunity to knockback and damage over time. If the player carrying it goes down, the Anchor Rune drops to the ground and other players can  to pick it up.
et.journal.ab.mech.s2.d: Falling into the abyss is fatal. Knockbacks and pulls can push players off the platforms; an active Anchor Rune prevents this.
et.journal.ab.tip.x:
Abyss Gates, Anchor Rune,
Bottomless Abyss
et.journal.bc.b.baba_yaga.s0.d: Pounds the target 3 times; the third blow releases a shockwave around the target.
et.journal.bc.b.baba_yaga.s1.d: Lands on the spot where a random player stood when the cast began, dealing damage and knocking up. Mythic: immediately follows with Broom Sweep.
et.journal.bc.b.baba_yaga.s2.d: Rides the mortar from one side of the square to the other, twice in an X, pushing players hit to the side.
et.journal.bc.b.baba_yaga.s3.d: Lights 4 skull lamps that each fire a 24-block green beam; the beams sweep 60° together for 6 sec. Touching a beam deals damage.
et.journal.bc.b.baba_yaga.s4.d: Cast at full energy; if Skull Lamp Fence is active, it waits until the fence ends. Within 20 sec: ①  2 unlit skull lamps; ② pick up 4 glowing poppy seed piles; ③ have someone standing on every glowing tile at once (one tile per player). If all are done, she is stunned for 10 sec and takes 20% more damage; otherwise she damages everyone and curses them (30% less healing taken for 20 sec).
et.journal.bc.b.baba_yaga.s5.d: Each time she wakes from a stun, her damage increases by 15%. Stacks.
et.journal.bc.b.empress.s0.d: Strikes the target twice; the second hit inflicts Frostbite, dealing damage every second for 6 sec. No Frostbite when solo without a companion.
et.journal.bc.b.empress.s1.d: The great chandelier drops 8 ice crystals near random players.
et.journal.bc.b.empress.s2.d: Multiplayer: encases a random player in ice for 6 sec, unable to move or use skills and taking damage every second. Breaking the ice frees them; the trapped player can also crack it by tapping Shift. If not broken within 6 sec, it explodes, hitting everyone within 5 blocks. Solo: an ice circle appears underfoot and seals after 3 sec.
et.journal.bc.b.empress.s3.d: An ice-sculpture courtier awakens at the north and south ends of the arena and slowly walks to the Empress; on arrival she gains the Crown of Ice shield. A courtier leaves an ice dome with a 3-block radius where it dies.
et.journal.bc.b.empress.s4.d: Damages everyone; damage taken inside an ice dome is reduced by 80%. All ice domes shatter afterwards.
et.journal.bc.b.empress.s5.d: Floats back to the throne and freezes the floor into mirror ice; moving in the hall becomes slippery.
et.journal.bc.b.empress.s6.d: Ice thorns burst from beneath her, one ring at a time from the inside out (one ring every 1.75 sec; only the next ring is marked on the floor). Touching them deals damage and launches you. Mythic: one extra ring.
et.journal.bc.b.empress.s7.d: Ice Scepter, Ice Prison, Royal Audience, Chandelier Shards and Permafrost Breath continue as before.
et.journal.bc.b.empress.s8.d: Damages everyone every 3 sec for the whole fight.
et.journal.bc.b.empress.t: B4 · Ice Palace Throne Hall · Two phases
et.journal.bc.b.fisherman.s0.d: Marks a 3-block-radius circle under a random player and casts the net 2 sec later, rooting those caught for 3 sec and dealing damage every second. The net stays on the ground for 15 sec; stepping in also traps you.
et.journal.bc.b.fisherman.s1.d: Throws a harpoon at a random player, hooking the first player in the line: within 5 blocks the Old Fisherman walks over; beyond 5 blocks he pulls the player to him. He then roots the target and channels for 6 sec, dealing damage every second. While channeling he has a shield (5% of current health) and the bar is gray; once the shield breaks he can be interrupted.
et.journal.bc.b.fisherman.s2.d: About every 20 sec, a glowing goldfish leaps up by the pier. If not killed within 8 sec, the Old Fisherman restores 25% health.
et.journal.bc.b.fisherman.s3.d: If not defeated, joins the Marena fight at half health, alternating Cast Net and Harpoon.
et.journal.bc.b.fisherman.t: Miniboss · Fish Market Pier (choose one: this or the Blacksmith)
et.journal.bc.b.marena.s0.d: There are 3 bonfires. Within 6.5 blocks of a lit bonfire she is Burning and takes 25% more damage. A doused bonfire can be relit by  it and standing next to it for 2 sec.
et.journal.bc.b.marena.s1.d: Smashes a 3×8 strip directly in front.
et.journal.bc.b.marena.s2.d: Lashes long ice ribbons at 3 random players.
et.journal.bc.b.marena.s4.d: Returns to the center and knocks every player to the edge, taking 80% less damage. Straw maidens join hands in a spinning, pulsing ring that damages and knocks back on touch. Ends when a player touches Marena herself; if no one does within 12 sec, the straw maidens explode, damaging everyone. She casts nothing else meanwhile. Mythic: two rings spinning in opposite directions.
et.journal.bc.b.marena.s5.d: Douses every bonfire except one random one (green circle on the ground). When the 5-sec cast ends, players not next to that bonfire take damage and are frozen for 2 sec.
et.journal.bc.b.marena.s6.d: Minibosses left alive in Segment 1 join the fight.
et.journal.bc.b.smith.s0.d: The first two blows hit the target; the third marks a 90°, 5-block cone in front and lands 1 sec later.
et.journal.bc.b.smith.s1.d: Every 2 sec for 6 sec, flings sparks at 6 spots, 3 under players and 3 near the Blacksmith; they land 1.7 sec later.
et.journal.bc.b.smith.s2.d: Releases steam, damaging nearby players and pushing them 8 blocks away.
et.journal.bc.b.smith.s3.d: If not defeated, joins the Marena fight at half health, alternating Triple Hammer and Spark Shower.
et.journal.bc.b.smith.t: Miniboss · Smithy Yard (choose one: this or the Old Fisherman)
et.journal.bc.b.vodyanoy.s0.d: The ice is slippery. Ice holes last 25 sec, up to 6 at a time. From 1 sec after a hole opens, stepping in drops you into the water: you are returned to your last safe spot and take damage equal to 25% of max health. A water imp crawls out 7 sec after a hole opens.
et.journal.bc.b.vodyanoy.s1.d: Attacks the target and makes them Soaked, increasing damage taken.
et.journal.bc.b.vodyanoy.s2.d: Marks 3 players with following crack circles; after 4 sec each cracks into an ice hole where they stand.
et.journal.bc.b.vodyanoy.s3.d: The oldest ice hole becomes a whirlpool, constantly pulling everyone on the ice floe toward it. Mythic: the holes from the last Ice Breaker also become whirlpools; their pulls add up or cancel out.
et.journal.bc.b.vodyanoy.s4.d: Marks a player; a few seconds later waterweed from the nearest ice hole grabs them and drags them toward it for up to 18 sec, pulling harder over time. Destroying the weed releases them; if they are dragged all the way, they take damage.
et.journal.bc.b.vodyanoy.s5.d: Sinks into an ice hole for 2 sec (can't be attacked), then bursts out of another, pushing away players within 5 blocks and damaging everyone; then all ice holes close.
et.journal.bc.bosses.i: Bing Chilling has 4 bosses, plus two Segment 1 minibosses (choose one).
et.journal.bc.m.barge_hauler.s0.d: Attacks a 180°, 6-block area in front, flinging players hit 8 blocks behind him.
et.journal.bc.m.bear_tamer.s0.d: Sends bears within 12 blocks into Frenzy for 8 sec: 30% more damage, and their next cast takes only 1.2 sec. Not cast with no bears nearby.
et.journal.bc.m.big_doll.s0.d: Alternates Straight Roll (3×12 strip) and Bounce Roll (rolls to the end, turns 45° and bounces 8 more blocks), knocking back players it hits.
et.journal.bc.m.chain_bear.s0.d: Hits make the target bleed for 8 sec, taking damage every second; another hit resets the timer.
et.journal.bc.m.chain_bear.s1.d: Alternates sweeping 180° in front and 180° behind within 5 blocks; hits cause bleeding.
et.journal.bc.m.frozen_captain.note: Rotation: Anchor Throw → Broadside → Chain Whirl → All Hands on Deck.
et.journal.bc.m.frozen_captain.s0.d: Throws the anchor under a random player, where it stays for 10 sec. The chain between the captain and the anchor moves with him and damages on touch.
et.journal.bc.m.frozen_captain.s1.d: Lays out 5 landing spots with a 3-block radius in a line through a random player; cannonballs land from one end to the other, knocking back players hit.
et.journal.bc.m.frozen_captain.s2.d: Swings the anchor around himself, damaging and pushing away players 3–8 blocks out.
et.journal.bc.m.frozen_captain.s3.d: Damages everyone and summons 2 Frozen Sailors.
et.journal.bc.m.giant_catfish.s1.d: Attacks 180° behind within 6 blocks and pushes players away.
et.journal.bc.m.giant_catfish.s2.d: Dives under the ice and follows a random player for 4 sec, stops for 1 sec, then bursts out, damaging and knocking up within 3 blocks and leaving an ice hole for 6 sec (stepping in freezes you stiff).
et.journal.bc.m.herb_hag.s0.d: Alternates throwing a poison flask (3-block radius under a random player, leaving a poison pool for 8 sec) and ice flasks (2.5-block radius under two random players, freezing stiff for 3 sec on hit).
et.journal.bc.m.hoop_bear.s0.d: Alternates Single Pounce (onto the spot of a random player 5–14 blocks away) and Double Pounce (onto two players; both spots appear together and the second lands 1 sec later).
et.journal.bc.m.hut.s0.d: Stomps the target twice; the third stomp releases a shockwave with a 4-block radius.
et.journal.bc.m.hut.s1.d: Opens its door toward a random player, alternately spewing ash in a 90°, 10-block cone or releasing 2 black cats.
et.journal.bc.m.hut.s2.d: Spins for 3 sec, damaging and pushing away players within 6 blocks every 0.5 sec. When it stops, the door faces a random player.
et.journal.bc.m.ice_cutter.s0.d: Channels for 5 sec, striking the ice at the start and every second after, 6 times in all. Each strike damages everyone and opens 10 crack circles (2.5-block radius) at random spots within 20 blocks, which split 1.7 sec later.
et.journal.bc.m.ice_elephant.s0.d: Aims at a random player for 2 sec (a 3×14 line follows them), locks the direction for 1 sec, then sprays water along the line for 3 sec.
et.journal.bc.m.ice_elephant.s1.d: Attacks 180° in front within 6 blocks and pushes players away.
et.journal.bc.m.ice_elephant.s2.d: Rears up and stomps, releasing a 6-block-radius shockwave that knocks up.
et.journal.bc.m.ice_guard.s0.d: Takes half damage from the front 90° (pale blue cone on the ground).
et.journal.bc.m.ice_guard.s1.d: Charges to where a random player stood when the cast began, damaging players in the path.
et.journal.bc.m.ice_guard.s2.d: Attacks 180° in front within 3.5 blocks. Mythic: follows Halberd Charge immediately.
et.journal.bc.m.ice_gunner.s0.d: Fires grapeshot in a 60°, 12-block cone toward a random player, dealing damage and knocking back 4 blocks.
et.journal.bc.m.ice_gunner.s1.d: Channels for 6 sec after the cast; every 0.2 sec it marks a 1.5-block-radius spot by a random player within 24 blocks, and a shell lands there 1.7 sec later.
et.journal.bc.m.ice_pike.s0.d: Releases a 6-block-radius shock ring, dealing damage and pushing players 8 blocks away.
et.journal.bc.m.kot_bayun.s0.d: Alternates attacking 90°, 5-block cones to the front-left and front-right.
et.journal.bc.m.kot_bayun.s1.d: Channels for 6 sec after the cast, adding a Drowsy stack to players within 15 blocks every 2 sec; at 3 stacks they fall asleep for 3 sec. Damage wakes them.
et.journal.bc.m.leshy.s0.d: Alternates a 180° frontal sweep and two 90° sweeps (front-left, then front-right).
et.journal.bc.m.leshy.s1.d: Swaps the positions of two random players within 20 blocks and damages them.
et.journal.bc.m.mid_doll.s0.d: Alternates a chasing spin (2.5 sec) and a straight dash (10 blocks).
et.journal.bc.m.miller.s0.d: Bursts flour under a random player, leaving white fog with a 4-block radius for 6 sec. Players in the fog are blinded.
et.journal.bc.m.miller.s1.d: Pushes a 90° shockwave toward the target that spreads 10 blocks out, dealing damage and knocking back 8 blocks.
et.journal.bc.m.morozko.note: Rotation: Ice Thorns → Frost Question → Ice Thorns → Blizzard.
et.journal.bc.m.morozko.s0.d: Raises 3 ice-thorn walls (2×18) nearby, parallel or in a triangle in turn, damaging players where they rise. The walls last 10 sec and damage and push away on touch.
et.journal.bc.m.morozko.s1.d: Frost flowers appear over every player's head; anyone who moves in the next 3 sec takes damage and is frozen.
et.journal.bc.m.morozko.s2.d: Damages everyone every second for 4 sec and slows them by 25%.
et.journal.bc.m.nightingale.note: Rotation: Whistle → Serpent Hiss → Whistle → Beast Roar.
et.journal.bc.m.nightingale.s0.d: Releases a 60°, 20-block sound wave at a random player, pushing players far away and knocking them down for 1 sec. Alternates one wave and three waves (180° total).
et.journal.bc.m.nightingale.s1.d: Releases 3 S-shaped poison trails (2 wide, 16 long) that crawl toward random players; touching one poisons for 6 sec.
et.journal.bc.m.nightingale.s2.d: Damages everyone and pushes all players 8 blocks outward.
et.journal.bc.m.raven.s0.d: Flies low and dives to peck a random player every 3 sec.
et.journal.bc.m.rusalka.s0.d: Freezes the ground under a player (circle) or toward them (strip) for 8 sec. Standing on the mirror ice is slippery and deals damage every 0.5 sec.
et.journal.bc.m.rusalka.s1.d: Channels for 10 sec after the cast; every 2 sec it damages players within 20 blocks and makes them Soaked for 20 sec, increasing damage taken.
et.journal.bc.m.sbiten_seller.s0.d: Channels for 5 sec after the cast (dark green bar draining), during which monsters within 10 blocks restore 8% health every second. Both the cast and the channel can be interrupted.
et.journal.bc.m.shore_hunter.s0.d: A steady cast; when it finishes, shoots a blunt arrow at a random player in sight within 24 blocks. Walks toward players when it has no target.
et.journal.bc.m.skomorokh.s0.d: Marks 2.5-block-radius spots under 3 random players; the balls drop 2 sec later.
et.journal.bc.m.skomorokh.s1.d: Damages a random player within 15 blocks and puts them on Strings for 3 sec: unable to use skills and dragged 2 blocks toward the caster every second.
et.journal.bc.m.skull_lamp.s0.d: Fires a straight 2×16 green beam at a random player every 3 sec.
et.journal.bc.m.snow_maiden.s0.d: Throws a homing dart at a random player in sight. Walks toward players when it has no target.
et.journal.bc.m.snowball_kid.s0.d: Melee attacks, and every 2.5 sec throws a snowball at a random player within 12 blocks, knocking them back.
et.journal.bc.m.snowman.s0.d: Alternates Great Snowball (rolls a 16-block line toward a random player, growing as it goes, knocking back) and Broom Swat (120°, 6-block cone in front).
et.journal.bc.m.troika.s0.d: Charges along a 5×24 route, knocking back. Alternates a straight charge and a U-turn charge back (the return route appears 1.5 sec before it charges back).
et.journal.bc.m.troika.s1.d: Attacks 270° around itself within 8 blocks; the back is unaffected.
et.journal.bc.m.troika.s2.d: Gallops a full circle with a 10-block radius for 4 sec, damaging players outside the circle every 0.5 sec.
et.journal.bc.m.water_imp.s0.d: At the start of combat each one fixates on a random player, ignoring threat.
et.journal.bc.m.water_imp.s1.d: Melee hits give the target a Dragging stack, reducing movement speed. Stacks up to 3 times.
et.journal.bc.m.witch_apprentice.s0.d: A steady cast; when it finishes, damages a random player in sight within 24 blocks and adds a Curse stack, reducing healing taken by 10% for 10 sec. Stacks up to 3 times. Walks toward players when it has no target.
et.journal.fw.b.sunflower.s0.d: Three waves in a row during the cast; each marks 2.8-block-radius landing spots under up to 3 players. The flower head throws little suns that land 3 sec later, dealing damage.
et.journal.fw.b.sunflower.s1.d: Marks a player; 3 sec later a sunbeam comes down on where they are at that moment. From 1 sec after landing it burns a 3-block radius until the 3rd second. The sunbeam dries up any Blight in its range.
et.journal.fw.b.sunflower.s2.d: Burrows underground (immune), targets the farthest player, and bursts out there 3 sec later dealing damage; leaves a Blight puddle where it was.
et.journal.fw.b.sunflower.s3.d: 5-block radius; stepping in deals damage (at most once per second). Disappears after 45 sec. Mythic: slowly grows, up to a 7.5-block radius.
et.journal.fw.b.sunflower.s4.d: Cast when out of energy: damages the whole party every second for 10 sec while regaining energy, and takes 50% increased damage meanwhile. Mythic: leaves a Blight puddle under each player when it ends.
et.journal.fw.b.titania.s0.d: Basic attack that deals magic damage to the target.
et.journal.fw.b.titania.s1.d: Slashes a 90°, 7.5-block cone in front. Mythic: the area grows to a frontal half-circle, 15 blocks.
et.journal.fw.b.titania.s10.d: Petal Whirlwind, Moon Blade, Queen's Favorite and Charming Song continue as before.
et.journal.fw.b.titania.s2.d: Damages players within 10 blocks and turns their screen upside down for 3 sec.
et.journal.fw.b.titania.s3.d: A 3-sec cast that damages every player in the arena every second.
et.journal.fw.b.titania.s4.d: Marks a player who sprouts a donkey head; it bursts after 6 sec, and the damage is split among all players within 5 blocks. Not cast with only one player.
et.journal.fw.b.titania.s5.d: Swaps two players' positions. Solo: teleports you to a random spot in the arena instead.
et.journal.fw.b.titania.s6.d: Floats and is immune for up to 25 sec, summoning 2 attendant fairies that cast Nightfall, damaging the party and applying Darkness for 3 sec. Surviving attendants stay into Phase 2 and keep casting.
et.journal.fw.b.titania.s7.d: The arena darkens. While attendants live, the party gains a Night Chill stack every 3 sec and takes damage; each stack increases the damage by 10%.
et.journal.fw.b.titania.s8.d: Creates a 3-block-radius safe ring nearby; then a shockwave sweeps outward from it across the arena, damaging and knocking up players outside the ring.
et.journal.fw.b.titania.s9.d: Every 20 sec marks a new boundary; 3 sec later the hedges grow inward one ring (down to a 4-block radius), damaging all players and pushing them away.
et.journal.fw.b.willow.s0.d: Throws seeds from her hands that land 2–5 blocks around her, 5 per player. Stepping on a seed deals damage and adds a Rose Thorn stack; each stack increases the damage of the next seed stepped on by 50% (lasts 8 sec in multiplayer, 2 sec solo).
et.journal.fw.b.willow.s1.d: Snips the target three times; the third snip hits hardest.
et.journal.fw.b.willow.s2.d: A 5-block-radius circle appears on and follows every player, bursting when the cast ends; where circles overlap, each one deals its damage. Seeds inside the circles are cleared.
et.journal.fw.b.willow.s3.d: Damages the whole party. All remaining seeds hatch into Sproutlings, and the thorn walls around the greenhouse close in one ring.
et.journal.fw.b.willow.s4.d: For each Sproutling hatched, the party gains a stack, taking damage every second for 5 sec.
et.journal.fw.m.acolyte.s0.d: Fires a homing sun bolt at a random player within 20 blocks.
et.journal.fw.m.acolyte.s1.d: Releases a 14-block beam that sweeps 60° to the left or right.
et.journal.fw.m.apprentice.s0.d: Throws a homing clod of earth at a random player within 18 blocks.
et.journal.fw.m.apprentice.s1.d: Scatters 3 glowing seeds that hatch into Sproutlings after 6 sec. A crushed seed won't hatch, and the player who crushes it takes damage. The pattern rotates: ring around itself, line toward the target, cluster at the target's feet.
et.journal.fw.m.barkguard.s0.d: Raises its axe in a cast, then chops a cone in front, dealing damage and knocking back 3 blocks. Nearby Barkguards take turns casting it.
et.journal.fw.m.barkguard.s1.d: The area grows to a 20-block-radius cone.
et.journal.fw.m.bull.s0.d: Marks a 12-block line toward a random player and charges along it 3 sec later, knocking back players hit. Hitting a wall or hedge stuns it for 3 sec, during which it takes 50% more damage.
et.journal.fw.m.bull.s1.d: Dirt churns under its feet for 3 sec, then it rears up and stamps, damaging everything within 4 blocks.
et.journal.fw.m.champion.note: Escorted by two Moon Heralds. Rotation: Moon Lance → Crescent Sweep → Moon Lance → Full Moon Spin.
et.journal.fw.m.champion.s0.d: Dashes in a straight line at a random player within 14 blocks, knocking back.
et.journal.fw.m.champion.s1.d: Sweeps all around; the 90° behind is unaffected.
et.journal.fw.m.champion.s2.d: Damages a full circle around itself.
et.journal.fw.m.champion.s3.d: At 50% health raises a shield for 4 sec, then again every 30 sec: damage taken from the front 120° is reduced by 90%, and it cannot turn meanwhile.
et.journal.fw.m.champion.s4.d: Other monsters within 8 blocks take 20% less damage (silver-blue circle on the ground).
et.journal.fw.m.dancer.s0.d: Dashes to a spot under a player, then spins in place while slowly advancing, damaging players it touches.
et.journal.fw.m.dancer.s1.d: With 3 or more dancers within 6 blocks, or when commanded by the Feast Hostess: 30% more damage, increased speed, and Whirling Dance grows larger and lasts longer.
et.journal.fw.m.herald.s0.d: A "don't look" eye appears over its head. When the cast ends, players within 20 blocks facing the caster fall asleep for 3 sec.
et.journal.fw.m.herald.s1.d: Monsters within 8 blocks take 30% less damage for 6 sec.
et.journal.fw.m.hostess.s0.d: Summons 4 Feast Dancers and makes dancers within 12 blocks Dance Together for 10 sec. Up to 4 on the field.
et.journal.fw.m.hostess.s1.d: Every second for 5 sec, marks a 2.5-block-radius circle under every player; petals fall there 2.5 sec later.
et.journal.fw.m.hound.s0.d: Crouches for 2.5 sec, marking where a random player is standing, then pounces there, damaging players within 2.5 blocks of the landing spot.
et.journal.fw.m.hound.s1.d: Topiary Hounds in the same pack pounce on the same player.
et.journal.fw.m.lasher.s0.d: Alternates Straight Lash (long strip in front) and Spin Lash (within 5 blocks all around; the 90° behind is unaffected).
et.journal.fw.m.lasher.s1.d: Thorns sprout where the lash struck, lasting 8 sec (Mythic 12 sec). Players who touch them take damage and are slowed.
et.journal.fw.m.matron.s0.d: Deals magic damage to the nearest player within 16 blocks.
et.journal.fw.m.matron.s1.d: Damages players within 10 blocks and Charms them for 4 sec.
et.journal.fw.m.matron.s2.d: Grows 3-block-radius mushroom rings under 2 players; they burst 2.5 sec later and knock up. Mythic: one ring per player.
et.journal.fw.m.matron.s3.d: Bursts ring by ring outward from the caster, one ring every 1.75 sec, 4 rings out to 14 blocks, knocking up players in range.
et.journal.fw.m.moth.s0.d: Circles the players, then dives along a 10-block line at a random player, blocking their vision on hit (Nightfall) for 3 sec. Stays on the ground for 2 sec after diving.
et.journal.fw.m.myconid.note: Inside the grotto; can be skipped.
et.journal.fw.m.myconid.s0.d: Other monsters within 8 blocks (12 on Heroic and above) deal 30% more damage and restore 1% health every second. The range is shown on the ground.
et.journal.fw.m.myconid.s1.d: On death, a spore sac grows over every player's head and bursts 3 sec later, hitting players within 4 blocks. The range is shown on the ground. Mythic: leaves a pollen cloud where it bursts.
et.journal.fw.m.petalspeaker.s0.d: Puts players within 10 blocks to sleep for 3 sec, unable to move or use skills. Damage wakes them.
et.journal.fw.m.petalspeaker.s1.d: When the cast ends, also heals monsters within 10 blocks for 20% of their health.
et.journal.fw.m.petalspeaker.s2.d: Throws a pollen flask at the target that bursts on landing.
et.journal.fw.m.pollinator.s0.d: Hits give the target an Allergy stack, reducing healing taken by 8% for 10 sec. Stacks up to 5 times.
et.journal.fw.m.queen.s0.d: Summons 3 worker bees. While workers live, the queen glows gold and takes 30% less damage.
et.journal.fw.m.queen.s1.d: Marks a 2.5-block-radius circle under a random player that turns into a puddle of honey 3 sec later, lasting 10 sec and slowing players inside.
et.journal.fw.m.queen.s2.d: Marks a 12-block line toward a random player, then dashes low along it, adding 2 Allergy stacks on hit.
et.journal.fw.m.scarecrow.note: Rotates three skills and never uses the same one twice in a row.
et.journal.fw.m.scarecrow.s0.d: 4 crows fly up around the scarecrow, each locking onto a player (repeating if there are fewer players) and diving along a marked 18-block path.
et.journal.fw.m.scarecrow.s1.d: After a 3-sec cast, whips up a whirlwind for 3 sec that damages players within 40 blocks every 0.5 sec.
et.journal.fw.m.scarecrow.s2.d: Damages a 120°, 8-block cone in front, knocking back 6 blocks and slowing.
et.journal.fw.m.sentinel.s0.d: Roots burst from the ground, rooting the target for 3 sec and dealing damage.
et.journal.fw.m.sentinel.s1.d: Allies within 4 blocks of the target are rooted too.
et.journal.fw.m.sentinel.s2.d: Roots burst from a ring 3.5–7 blocks around itself, rooting players in it for 2 sec and dealing damage.
et.journal.fw.m.sproutling.note: Appears in groups. The flower on its head depends on the area: azalea in the Prologue, rose in the West Wing, sunflower in the East Wing, eyeblossom on Moon Hill.
et.journal.fw.m.sproutling.s0.d: On death leaves a 2.5-block-radius pollen cloud for 6 sec. Players inside are slowed and take damage every second.
et.journal.fw.m.succulent.s0.d: Fires 10-block needles in 8 directions. The pattern rotates 22.5° after each cast.
et.journal.fw.m.thornshot.s0.d: Draws its bow at the nearest player for 1.5 sec and fires a homing thorn arrow. Walks toward the target when it is over 18 blocks away or out of sight.
et.journal.fw.m.wisp.note: 4 per lamppost, drifting in one after another.
et.journal.fw.m.wisp.s0.d: Drifts toward the nearest player; touching it burns them for 3 sec, dealing damage every second.
et.journal.fw.m.wisp.s1.d: Below 20% health it stops and casts for 3 sec, then self-destructs, damaging players within 3.5 blocks. Stuns and pulls can't interrupt it.
et.journal.gear.ab01.l: "Someone chalked the depth inside the faceplate: nine hundred fathoms."
et.journal.gear.ab02.l: "Slits are cut in both sides of the hood. They're for the gills."
et.journal.gear.ab03.l: "The bronze went green long ago. The barnacles on it are still opening and closing."
et.journal.gear.ab04.l: "A faceless circle is carved on the chest, just like the great stone gate in the trench."
et.journal.gear.ab05.l: "Washed a hundred times, and the fish smell still seeps out of the seams."
et.journal.gear.ab06.l: "Three layers of canvas patch the knees; the salt stains ring them like tide lines."
et.journal.gear.ab07.l: "A little seawater is still stuck under the scales."
et.journal.gear.ab08.l: "Found beside the trench mine rails, the straps caked in purple crystal dust."
et.journal.gear.ab09.l: "They followed the sea all the way down. A white ring of salt crusts the tops."
et.journal.gear.ab10.l: "The straps are dried kelp. Every step crumbles a little more."
et.journal.gear.ab11.d:
Every 12 sec in combat, a ring of tide wells up underfoot (radius 3, 6 sec);
allies standing in it heal 1.2% health per second
et.journal.gear.ab11.l: "The priests walked the tide steps in the courtyard. One wrong step and the hole breathes in."
et.journal.gear.ab12.l: "The hatch is open. The snapped end of the cable still trails off the altar."
et.journal.gear.ab13.d:
Against enemies below 35% health,
you deal +12.0% damage
et.journal.gear.ab13.l: "Obed cut down the mainsail, threw it over his shoulders and walked into the trench."
et.journal.gear.ab14.d:
Tears open a rift on the ground at your crosshair (up to 12 blocks) for 3 sec:
it keeps pulling normal enemies within 5 blocks to its center (elites and above aren't pulled)
and deals 40% magic damage per second to every enemy inside
et.journal.gear.ab14.l: "Silt keeps dripping from the hem. Whatever it drips on stays put."
et.journal.gear.ab15.d:
Leaps 6 blocks forward; on landing, enemies within 3 blocks
take 120% physical damage,
and normal enemies are stunned for 1 sec (elites and above immune)
et.journal.gear.ab15.l: "One sinking whale can feed the seabed for a hundred years."
et.journal.gear.abw01.l: "Made for fishing things out of wrecks. Lately, what it pulls up isn't things."
et.journal.gear.abw02.l: "A converted ship's anchor. The chain still drags on the ground."
et.journal.gear.abw03.l: "Carved from a Tuscan column, and just as plain."
et.journal.gear.abw04.l: "Barnacles ring the spearhead. It's even harder to pull back out."
et.journal.gear.abw05.l: "Squid carved on the spine, dates carved on the blade. The last date is tomorrow."
et.journal.gear.abw06.l: "A key ground into a blade. No door it opened ever closed again."
et.journal.gear.abw07.l: "The barnacles on its face are harder to deal with than the enemy."
et.journal.gear.abw08.l: "Cut from the same stone as the gate that seals the rift. The gate is missing a corner."
et.journal.gear.abw09.l: "Just the right size. It even came with a handle."
et.journal.gear.abw10.l: "Each prong points to a tide: the flood, the ebb, and the one that never comes back."
et.journal.gear.abw11.l: "An octopus head is carved at the top. The purple fire burned in its mouth for seven days."
et.journal.gear.abw12.l: "The coral is still alive. It grows a finger's width every year."
et.journal.gear.abw13.l: "A diver's chalk for marking depths. The last few marks are all squid."
et.journal.gear.abw14.l: "Don't stare at the light too long."
et.journal.gear.abw15.l: "The crystal reshapes itself. The grip is somewhere different every day."
et.journal.gear.abw16.l: "The needle went past the last mark long ago."
et.journal.gear.abw17.l: "Eight arms drape over the pedestal; two cradle a purple pearl."
et.journal.gear.abw18.l: "Don't worry, it's not awake yet. Probably."
et.journal.gear.abw19.l: "Shaved from a stranded whale's baleen. Drawing it smells like the sea."
et.journal.gear.abw20.l: "Snap the coral tips and they grow back, just a little crooked."
et.journal.gear.abw21.l: "The string is a crack. Draw it and you can hear the other side."
et.journal.gear.bc01.l: "At the Maslenitsa fair, nine out of ten people wear one of these hats."
et.journal.gear.bc02.l: "Knitted by Baba Yaga. The stitches are crooked in a charming way."
et.journal.gear.bc03.l: "A helmet made of ice. Wear it too long and your ears turn red."
et.journal.gear.bc04.l: "The red embroidery is the sun. It returns once winter is burned away."
et.journal.gear.bc05.l: "It has a fishy smell that never washes out."
et.journal.gear.bc06.l: "Stays dry after three days and nights of chasing through the snow."
et.journal.gear.bc07.l: "Scales shed by the Vodyanoy; cold and slick to the touch."
et.journal.gear.bc08.l: "A ring of frost flowers on the hem rustles as you walk."
et.journal.gear.bc09.l: "Thick boots of felted wool. Forty below is nothing."
et.journal.gear.bc10.l: "Glides across the frozen lake faster than anyone."
et.journal.gear.bc11.l: "The winter that must be burned at the end. Wearing it, you won't feel cold."
et.journal.gear.bc12.l: "A few strands of waterweed are still stuck in the mesh."
et.journal.gear.bc13.d:
Every 12 attacks (at most 1 per 0.3 sec), your next hit forges the target,
dealing 100% physical damage to enemies within 2 blocks of it
et.journal.gear.bc13.l: "Every scorch mark on the apron stands for a fine blade."
et.journal.gear.bc14.d:
Below 35% health, automatically freezes you for 2 sec (immune to damage, can't move);
when thawed, restores 16.0% health (120 sec cooldown)
et.journal.gear.bc14.l: "The Empress never kneels, so these greaves don't have a single scratch."
et.journal.gear.bc15.d:
Leaps 6 blocks backward;
enemies within 3 blocks of the takeoff point take 100% physical damage
et.journal.gear.bc15.l: "The boots sometimes wander off on their own. Remember to chase them down."
et.journal.gear.bcw01.l: "A ceremonial halberd; its edge is actually honed ice."
et.journal.gear.bcw02.l: "Chopped firewood in the snowy woods all winter long."
et.journal.gear.bcw03.l: "The frost on the blade never melts."
et.journal.gear.bcw04.l: "The hilt is antler. The hunter swears he found it."
et.journal.gear.bcw05.l: "Fished up from the bottom of the frozen lake. Still a little fishy."
et.journal.gear.bcw07.l: "The face is polished like a mirror, and it reflects your enemies' faces too."
et.journal.gear.bcw08.l: "Looks delicious, but it really is made of iron."
et.journal.gear.bcw09.l: "The two eagle heads are always arguing."
et.journal.gear.bcw10.l: "It flies if you ride it, but only toward the chicken-leg hut."
et.journal.gear.bcw11.l: "The crystal on top slowly shrinks when spring comes."
et.journal.gear.bcw12.l: "The Empress says: winter is not a season, it's her mood."
et.journal.gear.bcw14.l: "The only warm thing in this frozen land."
et.journal.gear.bcw15.l: "Snapped off the eaves. Just the right size."
et.journal.gear.bcw16.l: "Open one, there's another inside. The innermost one is the meanest."
et.journal.gear.bcw17.l: "It will be burned when winter ends, so it treasures every day."
et.journal.gear.bcw18.l: "Mirror, mirror, who fears the cold the most?"
et.journal.gear.bcw19.l: "Seven layers of horn and sinew; you can draw it even on horseback."
et.journal.gear.bcw20.l: "Draws best in winter. Remember to store it in the cellar come spring."
et.journal.gear.bcw21.l: "Fletched with snowy owl feathers, its arrows fly without a sound."
et.journal.gear.fw01.l: "The brim still has soil from Willow's greenhouse."
et.journal.gear.fw02.l: "Woven by the hostess of the moonlit feast herself. The flowers never wilt."
et.journal.gear.fw03.l: "Wearing it, the moonlight always seems brighter."
et.journal.gear.fw04.l: "Moss-covered bark armor. Little flowers bloom on it when it rains."
et.journal.gear.fw05.l: "The vines tighten on their own, as if reminding you to focus."
et.journal.gear.fw06.l: "Woven from ancient roots. Stand still too long and you'll want to burrow into the soil."
et.journal.gear.fw07.l: "Tie the cuffs tight so the queen's workers can't crawl in."
et.journal.gear.fw08.l: "Segmented shell plates that click when you bend."
et.journal.gear.fw10.l: "A little blue flame flickers at the ends of the laces."
et.journal.gear.fw11.d:
Hits have a 15% chance to inflict Bee Venom on the target:
each stack deals 10% magic damage per second for 6 sec, up to 5 stacks
et.journal.gear.fw11.l: "The queen's crown is made from the sweetest batch of beeswax."
et.journal.gear.fw12.d:
Taking damage has a 20% chance to release a flock of crows
that peck the nearest enemy for 150% physical damage over 3 sec (8 sec cooldown)
et.journal.gear.fw12.l: "Three crows that refuse to leave are hiding under this hat."
et.journal.gear.fw13.l: "After a whole day in the sun, it's still warm to hug at night."
et.journal.gear.fw14.d:
Opens a fairy ring underfoot (radius 3, 8 sec);
allies inside gain +90 haste
et.journal.gear.fw14.l: "Wherever the Fairy Queen's hem sweeps, a ring of mushrooms grows."
et.journal.gear.fw15.d:
Dashes 8 blocks forward,
then gains +40% movement speed for 3 sec
et.journal.gear.fw15.l: "Fireflies light the next step for whoever wears them."
et.journal.gear.fww01.l: "The blade is living wood and grows a new ring every year."
et.journal.gear.fww02.l: "The blade is the horn the bull shed. It's still looking for it."
et.journal.gear.fww03.l: "Even the grip has thorns. Wear gloves."
et.journal.gear.fww04.l: "The most popular blade in Willow's greenhouse; it's pruned ten thousand branches."
et.journal.gear.fww05.l: "Ground from a fallen giant thorn; it gets sharper the more you use it."
et.journal.gear.fww06.l: "Swinging it feels like dancing, and whoever it pierces spins along."
et.journal.gear.fww07.l: "A single slab of old bark. Knock on it and it thumps."
et.journal.gear.fww08.l: "When danger comes, the shield rolls itself up."
et.journal.gear.fww09.l: "The face always turns toward the sun."
et.journal.gear.fww10.l: "An umbrella on rainy days; it puffs spores when it's sunny."
et.journal.gear.fww11.l: "The flower head turns to follow your spells."
et.journal.gear.fww12.l: "The vines quietly wrap around the hand that holds it, as if holding hands."
et.journal.gear.fww13.l: "Hold it too long and your hands get sticky. Smells lovely."
et.journal.gear.fww15.l: "No matter how hard you blow, the blue flame won't go out."
et.journal.gear.fww16.l: "A secret that refuses to bloom lives inside the bud."
et.journal.gear.fww17.l: "Its light draws a whole swarm of moon moths."
et.journal.gear.fww18.l: "Every mushroom in the book has a little fairy drawn next to it."
et.journal.gear.fww19.l: "Pull the thorns off the bow and they grow back."
et.journal.gear.fww20.l: "Made of birch bark; it shines silver in the moonlight."
et.journal.gear.fww21.l: "Wrapped in spider silk. The fairies say it's for drying dew."
et.journal.gear.pm01.l: "At the highest note, all the bead strings jingle together."
et.journal.gear.pm02.l: "Burned full of little holes by flying sparks."
et.journal.gear.pm03.l: "Every dragon scale embroidered on the back is gold thread."
et.journal.gear.pm04.l: "Ouyezi's apprentice says: good armor must first survive a thousand hammer blows."
et.journal.gear.pm05.l: "Dry weather, mind your candles and fires."
et.journal.gear.pm06.l: "Fluffy lion-leg trousers that make every leap lighter."
et.journal.gear.pm07.l: "Cooled lava that happened to set in the shape of greaves."
et.journal.gear.pm08.l: "There's still an unfinished bag of roasted chestnuts in the pocket."
et.journal.gear.pm09.l: "A head taller than everyone, and sees farther too."
et.journal.gear.pm10.l: "Walk over hot coals without burning your feet."
et.journal.gear.pm11.d:
Lion's roar: deals 150% physical damage in a 120° cone 6 blocks ahead
and stuns normal enemies for 1.5 sec (elites and above immune)
et.journal.gear.pm11.l: "The blinking eyes are bronze mirrors that catch the light."
et.journal.gear.pm12.l: "The night-patrolling god leaves his lantern for those who are lost."
et.journal.gear.pm13.d:
Attacks have a 5% chance to burst into flames around the target,
splitting 150% magic damage among all enemies within 5 blocks
et.journal.gear.pm13.l: "Still beating, and hot to the touch."
et.journal.gear.pm14.d:
Pulls out a random treasure, granting one for 20 sec:
attack +24.0%, haste / crit / mastery +200,
or crit damage +22.5%
et.journal.gear.pm14.l: "The conjurer says: "The bag has everything, except what you want.""
et.journal.gear.pm15.d:
Each cooldown skill you use
makes your next attack deal 40% extra damage
et.journal.gear.pm15.l: "The father of swordsmithing walked through a thousand quenching baths in these."
et.journal.gear.pmw01.l: "Legend says one swing split a mountain on the crater plain."
et.journal.gear.pmw02.l: "The one on stage is wooden. This one is real."
et.journal.gear.pmw03.l: "Fired in the kiln for seven days and nights; it rings when struck."
et.journal.gear.pmw04.l: "Ouyezi says it's far from done, but it's already very sharp."
et.journal.gear.pmw05.l: "The tassel is a dragon whisker that fell off during the dragon dance."
et.journal.gear.pmw06.l: "Picks up coals, stokes fires, and cuts people too."
et.journal.gear.pmw08.l: "A wheel taken off the cart; it still rolls smoothly."
et.journal.gear.pmw09.l: "Warm to the touch; very popular in winter."
et.journal.gear.pmw10.l: "One flick of the tassel and the audience falls silent."
et.journal.gear.pmw12.l: "The fire patterns burn themselves in, a little different every day."
et.journal.gear.pmw13.l: "Not one of the talismans wrapped around it has burned."
et.journal.gear.pmw14.l: "One breath and it lights. Much handier than flint."
et.journal.gear.pmw15.l: "A tail feather of the Bifang. Holding it makes you want to stand on one leg."
et.journal.gear.pmw16.l: "One strike and the whole street knows the show is starting."
et.journal.gear.pmw17.l: "For revealing demons. On people it only shows their dark circles."
et.journal.gear.pmw18.l: "The little figures on the lamp keep running. They've run for a hundred years."
et.journal.gear.pmw19.l: "There used to be ten suns in the sky, so don't go drawing at it carelessly."
et.journal.gear.pmw20.l: "It crackles when fully drawn. Very popular at New Year."
et.journal.gear.pmw21.l: "Cut from a backstage bamboo pole; the tips still bear red ribbons from the last show."
et.journal.gear.un01.l: "The soles carry dust that doesn't belong to this world."
et.journal.gear.un02.d: Drink a Major Red Potion: instantly restore 24.0% health
et.journal.gear.un02.l: "Tastes like burnt strawberries, but it really works."
et.journal.gear.un03.l: "There's nothing in the shadows but you."
et.journal.gear.un04.d:

et.journal.gear.un04.l: "A clear chime that can wake anyone from a nightmare."
et.journal.gear.un05.d:

(only healers have mana)

et.journal.gear.un06.l: "Nobody can read the talisman's writing, including whoever wrote it."

Sounds the horn: all allies within 15 blocks

et.journal.pm.b.fenghuang.s0.d: Pecks the target every 3 sec, causing bleeding for 5 sec. Not cast in solo play.
et.journal.pm.b.fenghuang.s1.d: A 2.5-block-radius circle appears under and follows every player; 3 sec later it damages the other players inside. A fire chick then hatches and casts the interruptible Flame Feather Arrow.
et.journal.pm.b.fenghuang.s2.d: Sends 7 fire tornadoes from one of four directions across the whole island; the middle one breaks on the square pillar, leaving a strip directly behind the pillar unaffected. Mythic: 50% chance of a second wave 3 sec later.
et.journal.pm.b.fenghuang.s3.d: Marks a red line toward a random player; 3 sec later breathes a column of fire for 4.5 sec while turning 45° left or right. Mythic: turns 90°.
et.journal.pm.b.fenghuang.s4.d: Beats its wings fiercely for 5 sec, constantly pushing players within 30 blocks outward and damaging the party every 1.5 sec.
et.journal.pm.b.fenghuang.s5.d: Folds and spreads its wings, breathing fire, and enters Phase 2. Mythic: from Phase 2 on, Scorching Wind persists, damaging everyone every 3 sec.
et.journal.pm.b.fenghuang.s6.d: Marks 20 random circles with a 4.5-block radius on the island; 2 sec later white phoenixes dive from the sky.
et.journal.pm.b.fenghuang.s7.d: At zero health becomes a phoenix egg: break it within 20 sec to win; otherwise it is reborn once, restoring 30% health with 30% more damage, and Phase 2 starts over.
et.journal.pm.b.ouyezi.s0.d: Roots the target and hammers twice; the third blow is split if 2 or more players are within 3 blocks of the target, otherwise it damages the whole party. Solo: hops 3 times instead, each landing on a circle underfoot.
et.journal.pm.b.ouyezi.s1.d: Fires 3 iron sparks in each of 8 directions.
et.journal.pm.b.ouyezi.s2.d: Marks 3-block-radius landing spots under 3 players; sparks land 1.7 sec later, then 7 more land at random across the arena.
et.journal.pm.b.ouyezi.s3.d: A quarter of the arena (including the center) glows red for 3 sec, then floods with molten iron for 10 sec; standing in it deals damage every 0.5 sec. Moves clockwise each time. Mythic: after the first Sword Blanks, floods two opposite quarters at once.
et.journal.pm.b.ouyezi.s4.d: Becomes immune as glowing sword blanks appear (2 solo, 3 in multiplayer, 4 on Mythic with 2+ players). Players can  to pick one up and carry it to a quenching trough; carrying one deals damage over time and slows. If not all are quenched within 20 sec, damages everyone and burns them for 20 sec.
et.journal.pm.b.yanshi.s0.d: Rears up and stomps, sending a ring outward from its feet, 3 times; players with feet on the ground when the ring passes take damage.
et.journal.pm.b.yanshi.s1.d: Stomps 4 times (uneven rhythm); the 5th is a heavy drum: players not crouching take damage, are rooted for 2 sec and launched.
et.journal.pm.b.yanshi.s3.d: The embroidered ball bounces at a random player 3 times, marking a 2.5-block-radius landing spot first each time.
et.journal.pm.b.yanshi.s4.d: Roars in a 120°, 10-block cone in front, damaging and pushing away. Mythic: roars 3 times, turning 120° each time.
et.journal.pm.b.yanshi.s5.d: Claps 90° to the left and right, one after the other. Mythic: 4 claps; the first three randomly left or right, the last on both sides at once.
et.journal.pm.b.yanshi.s6.d: A glowing "greens" hangs from a random pole; players have 6 sec to  and grab it. The lion aims at the holder for 3 sec, locks on for 1 sec and charges: players hit take damage and are launched, hitting the holder eats the greens, and hitting a wall stuns it for 10 sec with 30% more damage taken. If no one grabs it, the lion eats it. Each greens eaten increases its damage by 20%.
et.journal.pm.b.yeyoushen.s0.d: Fires a homing soul arrow at a random player.
et.journal.pm.b.yeyoushen.s1.d: Leaps to the farthest player, damaging within 4 blocks on landing and leaving a fire circle for 10 sec. Solo: lands where the target stood when the cast began; multiplayer: the landing spot follows the target. Mythic with 3+ players: players hit burn for 8 sec.
et.journal.pm.b.yeyoushen.s2.d: Locks onto a random player and slowly follows them; chat shows who is locked on. Up to 2 at a time. While a lantern exists, the party takes damage every 1.5 sec, 5% more each time. On touching a player or after 15 sec it explodes, damaging the party; on touching an empty lamp stand it is collected and the stand stores energy.
et.journal.pm.b.yeyoushen.s3.d: For 5 sec, each energized lamp stand hurls soul fire at a random player every second; it deals damage within 4.5 blocks of the landing spot 2.5 sec later. The stands are emptied afterwards.
et.journal.pm.m.arrowsmith.s0.d: A steady cast; when it finishes, fires a homing molten arrow.
et.journal.pm.m.banner.s0.d: Plants a fire banner in front of itself, increasing the damage of monsters within 8 blocks by 30%. Only one exists at a time; the banner falls when its pack is wiped out.
et.journal.pm.m.bellsmith.s0.d: Strikes a bell tone, damaging players within 10 blocks.
et.journal.pm.m.bellsmith.s1.d: Every second releases a shock ring from its feet that spreads out to 12 blocks, three in all; each one damages and pushes players away.
et.journal.pm.m.bifang.s0.d: One beat of its wings sends fire feathers into the sky. 2.3 sec later they fall: one under every player and two more 5–9 blocks around them, each damaging within 2.5 blocks of where it lands.
et.journal.pm.m.bifang.s1.d: Dives along a 4×28 route at a random player within 30 blocks, pushing players away and leaving flames along the path for 8 sec.
et.journal.pm.m.bifang.s2.d: Damages every player within 30 blocks every 3 sec during combat.
et.journal.pm.m.fangxiang.s0.d: Alternates Halberd Peck (2×12 strip toward a random player) and Halberd Sweep (180°, 6 blocks in front, toward the target).
et.journal.pm.m.fire_breather.s0.d: Casts toward a random player within 10 blocks, then breathes fire in a 90°, 8-block cone in front for 1.5 sec, dealing damage every 0.5 sec.
et.journal.pm.m.fire_rat.s0.d: Leaves a patch of fire underfoot every second, lasting 3 sec.
et.journal.pm.m.fire_shaman.s0.d: Sets players within 20 blocks on fire for 6 sec, dealing damage every second.
et.journal.pm.m.fire_toad.s0.d: Lashes its tongue in a line toward a random player within 10 blocks, pulling the nearest player on the line in front of itself.
et.journal.pm.m.fire_toad.s1.d: Releases a shockwave within 5 blocks, dealing damage and pushing players away.
et.journal.pm.m.fire_toad.s2.d: On death splits into 3 small fire toads.
et.journal.pm.m.flame_chorister.s0.d: Fires a homing fire note at a random player within 20 blocks.
et.journal.pm.m.flame_chorister.s1.d: Damages players within 15 blocks and silences them for 2 sec.
et.journal.pm.m.flame_sprite.s0.d: Floats above the ground; every 3 sec it casts for 1 sec and throws a homing fireball.
et.journal.pm.m.founder.s0.d: Wipes the sweat from its brow; the cast has no other effect when it ends.
et.journal.pm.m.founder.s1.d: Pours a straight or V-shaped channel of molten iron toward a random player within 16 blocks, lasting 10 sec. Standing on it deals damage every 0.5 sec.
et.journal.pm.m.ganjiang.note: Rotation: Sword Array → Quench → Sword Array → Open Furnace.
et.journal.pm.m.ganjiang.s0.d: Marks landing spots under every player and at two other places; 3 sec later swords fall from the sky and stay planted for 12 sec. Fire lines connect neighboring swords within 12 blocks of each other and damage on touch.
et.journal.pm.m.ganjiang.s1.d: Releases steam within 8 blocks, pushing players away and pulling out every planted sword.
et.journal.pm.m.ganjiang.s2.d: A wave of fire spreads from its feet out to 15.5 blocks, damaging every player in the area.
et.journal.pm.m.huodou.s0.d: Breathes fire in a 3×14 strip ahead for 2 sec, leaving fire trails on the ground for 6 sec.
et.journal.pm.m.huodou.s1.d: Marks where a random player within 16 blocks is standing, then pounces there, damaging within 3 blocks of the landing spot.
et.journal.pm.m.huodou.s2.d: Every 10 sec devours fire on the ground within 12 blocks; each patch eaten increases its damage by 10%. Stacks up to 5 times.
et.journal.pm.m.kaishan.s0.d: Melee hits give the target a Sunder stack, increasing damage taken.
et.journal.pm.m.kaishan.s1.d: Alternates Overhead Chop (3×12 strip in front) and Sweep (within 5 blocks all around; the 90° behind is unaffected).
et.journal.pm.m.kiln_stoker.s1.d: Marks landing spots under 3 random players within 20 blocks; 2.3 sec later burning coals fall, damaging within 2.5 blocks and leaving coal beds for a while.
et.journal.pm.m.lantern_kid.s0.d: On death, the nearest Lantern Kid within 8 blocks gains a Blazing stack, increasing damage and movement speed by 25%. Stacks up to 3 times.
et.journal.pm.m.mohist.s0.d: Adjusts the mechanism in its hands; the cast has no other effect when it ends.
et.journal.pm.m.mohist.s1.d: Alternates deploying a Fire Wheel (lands 2–5 blocks beside a player; after a 3-sec warning, two 6-block fire lines spin a full circle) and Fire Caltrops (a 3-block-radius spike field under a player that stays up to 15 sec and triggers when stepped on, dealing damage and slowing).
et.journal.pm.m.nuo_witch.s0.d: Marks a 4-block-radius circle on a random player that moves with them and explodes after 3 sec, damaging every player inside.
et.journal.pm.m.nuo_witch.s1.d: Marks a 2.5-block-radius circle on a random player that moves with them and explodes after 3 sec; the damage is split among players inside.
et.journal.pm.m.peach_archer.s0.d: A steady cast; when it finishes, fires a homing thorn arrow.
et.journal.pm.m.pyrotechnist.s0.d: Fires a homing firework rocket at a random player within 24 blocks.
et.journal.pm.m.pyrotechnist.s1.d: Cast after every 3 Firework Rockets: fires one rocket at each player within 24 blocks.
et.journal.pm.m.smith_apprentice.s0.d: Grinds the hammer in its hands; the cast has no other effect when it ends.
et.journal.pm.m.terracotta_general.s0.d: Alternates Overhead Chop (14×3 strip in front) and Heat Wave (ring 3–10 blocks around).
et.journal.pm.m.terracotta_general.s1.d: At 50% health its clay shell cracks open: attack speed and movement speed increase by 30%, and Kiln Fire Slash is cast more often.
et.journal.pm.m.troupe_master.note: Rotation: Fire Hoops → Dragon Dance → Fire Hoops → Finale Fireworks.
et.journal.pm.m.troupe_master.s0.d: Alternates Hoop Ring (scatters as many fire hoops as there are players; each burns a ring 3–10 blocks out, and within 3 blocks of the center is unaffected) and Fire Basin (a solid circle of fire drops under every player).
et.journal.pm.m.troupe_master.s1.d: A fire dragon dashes along a marked S-shaped path, launching players it hits.
et.journal.pm.m.troupe_master.s2.d: Six fireworks shoot up; when the cast ends, every player in the area takes damage.
et.journal.pm.m.watchman.s0.d: Casts every 10 sec, calling the nearest other pack within 24 blocks that isn't yet in combat to join the fight.
et.journal.pm.m.wooden_ox.s0.d: Charges a random player 4–18 blocks away along a route (straight, or turning 45° midway, in turn), pushing players hit and leaving fire trails along the way for 4 sec. Unaffected by tank threat.
et.journal.ui.home.i: Boss skills, monster bestiary and loot for every dungeon. Pick a dungeon first.
et.journal.ui.legend: Yellow bar = interruptible; after a melee interrupt the enemy can't cast for 4 sec, after a ranged interrupt for 6 sec (elites and above only can't reuse that spell). Gray bar = interrupts don't work: regular monsters are stopped by stuns, silences and pulls; large monsters pause for as long as they are stunned; elites and above ignore stuns. [!] = major ability, shown with a "!" alert on screen; [Tank] = hits the tank in melee range, or the nearest player if there is none.
et.journal.ui.loot.armor.i: Every piece has Strength, Stamina and Armor, plus two secondary stats (green); values depend on item level.
et.journal.ui.loot.rule: The Trial Chest by the exit after clearing: each player s to take their own share. Each run drops 1–3 items (by party size) from this zone's armor, special gear and universal special gear; 1 in 5 is a weapon. Quality depends on difficulty: Normal green, Heroic blue, Mythic and Keystone purple. Salvage, reforge or upgrade what you don't need at the Elemental Forge.
et.journal.ui.loot.special.i: Orange names with random secondary stats, plus a special skill (up to 2 active at once: G → "Gear & Stats…"). Numbers in the descriptions assume Mythic quality (item level 100).

et.msg.tut.e1.chat: Swing at the straw dummy three times in a row: wait for the charge bar under your crosshair to fill each time (an uncharged swing resets to the first). The third swing is Heavy Strike, the strongest, and your skill icons glow for 1 sec afterwards. Land 2 Heavy Strikes to clear.
et.msg.tut.e2.chat: Each hit stacks Openings on the target (amber bar at the bottom of the screen, up to 10). Opening Strike consumes all Openings; more stacks hurt more. Build 5 or more and use it once; then try a combo: use Opening Strike within 1 sec after a Heavy Strike (while the icon glows) to stun the target for 0.25 sec. Elites and above can't be stunned.
et.msg.tut.e3.chat: Against a pack:  your weapon (slot 1) to stack Openings on enemies within 4 blocks, then  slot 3 for Whirlwind, which consumes Openings from everything around you; each enemy consumed raises damage and shortens the cooldown. Hit 3 or more with Whirlwind, then defeat the 4 trainees.
et.msg.tut.e4.chat: A yellow cast bar above an enemy means it can be interrupted. Take Counterspell from slot 6 and  while aiming at the casting mage (within 8 blocks). After an interrupt, regular and large monsters can't cast for 4 sec, and elites and above can't reuse that spell for 4 sec (6 sec for ranged classes' Counterspell). It only goes on cooldown when it succeeds, so missing costs nothing. Interrupt twice to clear.
et.msg.tut.e5.chat: A red circle on the ground means that spot is hit in 3 sec. Step out when you see one; dodge one Ground Slam.
et.msg.tut.e5.sub: Red circle → step out within 3 sec
et.msg.tut.e6.chat: Final test: the arena holds 4 packs you've seen before. Battle Fury (slot 4 ) raises haste for 15 sec and makes every charged swing a Heavy Strike, great for opening. Each monster defeated adds to Enemy Forces (green bar at the top); real trials need 100%% Enemy Forces to clear, and here 100%% opens the boss gate.
